dialogues.speaker: Paivio
dialogues.text: I really want to see the Lightkeepers' training grounds... But I can't possibly leave Dragana here on her own.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The two of you are...?

dialogues.speaker: Paivio
dialogues.text: Hello. My name is Paivio, and this is my younger sister Dragana.

dialogues.speaker: Paivio
dialogues.text: Please don't worry, there's nothing to be concerned about. We're simply waiting here for our friend.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Illuga</color> looks like he has something to say...?)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Paivio! How have the two of you been?

dialogues.speaker: Paivio
dialogues.text: Oh, Illuga, how are you? Ha, beat me to the punch with the greeting! We're doing well, thanks. But honestly, we're all thinking of you, permanent frontline fixture that you are.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, I know I should come back to see you all more often. But don't worry, I'm doing well here too.

dialogues.speaker: Paivio
dialogues.text: Eh, don't sweat it. Dragana and I will be here in Piramida pretty often for the selections anyway, so we can come see you instead!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: How have the selections gone so far?

dialogues.speaker: Paivio
dialogues.text: Mmm... I haven't quite made it yet, but I can feel it, I'm really close now. Pretty sure I'll nail it on the next try! As for Dragana... you should definitely ask her yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: There's no rush, so relax. The bar is set so high here because the work the Lightkeepers do is truly dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Paivio
dialogues.text: Yeah, I get it! Just you wait — one day, I'm going to be a warrior just like you!

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: That's the spirit. Well then, I'll be waiting for you two right here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry to disturb you. Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Paivio
dialogues.text: Please, go ahead. I have to wait here for Dragana still, and I have no idea how much longer that's going to take...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like the two of you are really close.

dialogues.speaker: Paivio
dialogues.text: Of course! I mean, we grew up side-by-side. But now, he's already this Lightkeeper big shot, and I... am nowhere close.

dialogues.speaker: Paivio
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, he's always been incredibly thoughtful and responsible, even when we were kids. He's a fantastic person, plain and simple — the kind of guy you can't even bring yourself to envy.

dialogues.speaker: Paivio
dialogues.text: *Sigh* If only I were a bit stronger, a bit more capable, he might not have had it so tough... You know, he hasn't come back even once this whole time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It can be stressful to stand in the glare of a friend's brilliance.

dialogues.speaker: Paivio
dialogues.text: Heh, you're so right! It is stressful being his friend. But he's also one of the reasons I keep trying to become better.

dialogues.speaker: Paivio
dialogues.text: We're about the same age, but here I am, still not a Lightkeeper. It's time for me to really pull my socks up.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So... are you just going to keep waiting there?

dialogues.speaker: Paivio
dialogues.text: Yeah, and that's alright. He must be really busy with his work now, and we wouldn't want to get in his way.

dialogues.speaker: Paivio
dialogues.text: It's just going to be for a short while anyway. He waited for us plenty when we were kids, so I'll call us square!
